original_requirement: Design a shadow-only Short Planning V2 that decomposes the current planning contract into authority-bound bounded artifacts, dependency-aware validation/recovery, deterministic merge and global semantic closure, using the sealed real Call 1 non-convergence evidence without changing production.
closed_world_justification: Not applicable: the design deliberately spans Planning, compiler/topology, causal/manifest, Draft consumption, recovery, diagnostics and authority boundaries.
operational_definition: Map current wire and assembled contracts; preserve unknown historical details; propose seven stages with immutable artifacts, impact closure, bounded recovery and a shadow Slice 1 that cannot become Draft authority.
why_not_fixed: This task is architecture/evidence only. Planning V1 production behavior and the initial semantic-conversion non-convergence remain unchanged until separately authorized implementation and validation.
forbidden_narrowing: Do not call an eight-leaf schema small when cardinality and recovery atomicity remain large
Do not infer Call 1 field/rule/entities from semantic_validation_failed
Do not make V2 prompt decomposition without artifact freeze
Do not treat parser success as semantic success
Do not block offline Slice 1 on PTR12 raw-shape observer

constraint_traceability.requirement: Field-by-field current contract and ownership counts
constraint_traceability.implementation: Wire contract map plus separate Runtime assembled-contract map; five deterministic/authority paths leave model output
Preserve exact observed boundary and mark path/rule/invariant/entities UNKNOWN because normalizer discards ValueError detail
Seven stages, stable envelopes, hash dependencies, CAS revisions and explicit thaw proof
SEMANTIC_IMPACT_CLOSURE_V1 plus six-level recovery ladder and no-progress terminal

constraint_traceability.requirement: Preserve downstream authority and Draft interface
constraint_traceability.implementation: Local deterministic merge/global closure and minimum Draft projection compatible with PlanningDocumentIR and ShortExecutionManifest
Event realization artifacts run only in isolated shadow/offline replay; V1 remains sole authority

projected_failure_mechanisms: incorrect dependency declaration under-invalidates frozen artifacts
under-broad closure accepts adjacent semantic regressions
compatibility projection diverges from V1 Draft expectations
shadow metrics optimize parse rate instead of semantic correctness
controls: call/token estimator and hard materialized caps
model_output_not_applicable_evidence: Only docs/superpowers/reports/short-plan-v2-design is created. src and baml_src are unchanged; no Prompt, model, route, retry, budget or validator behavior changed.
why_previous_tests_missed: Existing tests cover parsing, compilation, capacity packets, targeted later repair and PTR9 output guards. The consumed real Short exposed a conversion-layer diagnostic collapse before domain validation, where no independently frozen artifact or field dependency vector existed.

sibling_boundaries.evidence: Design reports only; no Runtime cutover.
Draft minimum contract is a design projection; Draft code is unchanged.
No production flow or authority change.
V2 design consumes immutable snapshots and forbids mutation.
No observer or adapter implementation; PTR12 priority is parallel.

remaining_risks: Exact historical Call 1 invalid path cannot be recovered retroactively.
Three proposed model-owned leaf classes are design abstractions; Slice 1 must validate real artifact shape and output-size estimates.
A future transition stage may require more typed semantic paths than the current exit_state abstraction.
No production or live parity validation has occurred for V2 because implementation is forbidden.
business_limitation: The design does not produce an accepted Planning artifact, enter Draft, repair the consumed real Short, or authorize a Provider call.
